title: State file lost on crash between write and replace

finding.claim: State file lost on crash between write and replace
finding.evidence:
tmp = STATE_PATH + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w") as fh:
        json.dump({"signature": sig}, fh)
    os.replace(tmp, STATE_PATH)
finding.recommendation: Write state atomically using a single file-descriptor operation (e.g., write to STATE_PATH directly with O_EXCL or use os.open with O_CREAT|O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC and ftruncate, then rename), or ensure the temp file is only committed after all side-effects succeed.

refutation.reason: Refuted by probe: with tmp-write + os.replace, a crash before the replace leaves the previous state file intact and only orphans the tmp file; worst case is one repeated alert, not state loss. The claimed data-loss mechanism is exactly what this pattern prevents.
